text: A workspace is where every dashboard, report, and semantic model in this chapter actually lives.
Here's a workspace's content list — a dashboard, a report, a workbook, a dataset, all grouped together. Everything you've published so far sits inside a workspace exactly like this.
Creating one takes a name and a few optional settings — a contact list, a workspace image, a linked OneDrive. All of it lives under Workspace settings, reachable any time.
Four roles control what colleagues can do inside your workspace: Admin has full control, Member can publish and add members, Contributor can publish but not manage access, and Viewer can only look.
Pin the workspaces you use most to the top of the list — small detail, but it saves real time once you're working across several of them.
One warning before you move on: deleting a workspace is permanent, no recovery. Lesson 70 covers what actually happens when you publish into one.
